newsitem.title: USA: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE MARKET LIGHTLY TESTED - USDA.
newsitem.headline: NEBRASKA FED CATTLE MARKET LIGHTLY TESTED - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady where the market was tested. Buyer inquiry good. Seller interest limited. Weekly volume of 51,700 did not "clean up" showlists. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1325 lbs - few loads 65.50-66.00; dressed basis 105.00.

Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1150 lbs - few loads 65.00; dressed basis 105.00. Confirmed - 2,100 Last Week - 2,200 Last Year - 300 Wk To Date - None. Sm Pd Lst Wk - None. Sm Pd Lst Yr - None.
